content.short: Empowa is a Cardano RealFi platform funding affordable housing through real-world property assets and finance.
content.description: Empowa is a Cardano RealFi platform focused on affordable housing in Africa. The project connects decentralized finance with real-world property assets, using blockchain-based funding to support housing supply in markets where structural barriers prevent people from accessing homes. Empowa frames the housing backlog as both a social challenge and a major investment opportunity. By linking capital providers with property development, it brings Cardano into real estate finance, impact investing, and sustainable community growth.
